name: Kusumgar Limited
summary: Kusumgar Limited manufactures, markets, and supplies a range of technical textile fabrics. It offers fabrics used in aerospace and defence applications, including tactical gear, rucksacks, ponchos, parachute systems, sleeping bags, slides and rafts, etc.; fabrics for wire harness tape systems in automobiles, mechanical rubber goods, and inflatable fabrics, as well as custom fabric solutions; and outdoor and lifestyle fabrics for synthetic performance wear, such as athleisure, winter wear, rainwear, fashion jackets and personal gear such as backpacks, luggage, sleeping bags, and tents.
